triggers.description: Bare Actuating implements, hands publication to Ship, and drives exhaustive review to closure.
Explicit modes select implement, triage, remediation-plan, or review-closeout.
Unqualified review, inspect, audit, or classify intent is non-mutating triage.

routes.description: Select and completely realize the current normalized Construction.
Acquire review and classify Counterexamples without mutation.
Accumulate Counterexample knowledge, normalize the Construction, publish, and obtain exhaustive convergence.
Hand a current ready-to-ship proof to Ship.
Apply the closure theorem to current artifacts and observations.

success_signals: exactly four authoritative artifact families
review findings never select repairs or grant mutation
Construction v4 is the sole carrier of causal basis semantic model normal form proof realization bindings supersession and retirements
Actuating alone selects the Construction operation next action review credit and closure
Ledger remains structurally passive and Ship owns every public effect
failure_signals: a fifth authority artifact review-path artifact accretion event or mutable workflow state is introduced
Ledger reviewer or supporting skill selects architecture mutation or closure
a public effect bypasses Ship
v3 bytes are reinterpreted as v4
clauses.rationale: Authority remains small while the Construction becomes the complete normal-form decision carrier.

success_signals: every currently applicable accepted stable class across the Goal lineage appears in the cumulative Counterexample Theory
duplicate witnesses campaign boundaries reviewer identity and finding order do not alter theory semantics
every accepted class maps to one causal generator or an evidenced instance-specific exception
one recurring class or two same-cause classes invalidates the prior candidate universe
the first review-entry subject remains immutable for forensic audit
failure_signals: Construction selection uses only the latest review wave
a subject change erases accepted class history
a later review-entry anchor replaces the first anchor
a shared-cause cluster receives another local repair without non-example separation proof
clauses.rationale: Knowledge accumulates monotonically and is quotiented before it can become implementation structure.

success_signals: realization-repair is selected only when exact required behavior already exists in the current semantic model
a local repair introduces no new state event transition ordering authority custody freshness correlation failure effect observation compatibility validator or proof constructor
realization-repair and ablation-repair declare an unchanged semantic model while architecture-repair declares a changed model
semantic novelty falsifies the current Construction and forces a successor before mutation
stable owner count is never used as proof of semantic-model stability
failure_signals: an absent transition state or authority rule is hidden inside realization-repair
another validator reconstructs information the selected representation forgets
owner-internal semantic growth is ignored because no new owner was added
a realization or ablation repair changes the semantic model
clauses.rationale: The first missing semantic constructor triggers rearchitecture instead of waiting for retrospective accretion.

success_signals: the architectonic comparison precedes architecture selection; its mnemonic is not compliance evidence
First Principles freezes an incumbent-independent basis before Universalist nomination
candidates are concrete semantic models with composable transformation axes
every candidate carries the same complete mandatory obligation core
at least one candidate is incumbent-independent
Metanoetic runs once only on a live unchanged decision surface
Reduce challenges disputable factors without selecting
reordering the same complete theory yields an equivalent selected Construction or the same incomparable minima
failure_signals: four transformation labels are treated as mutually exclusive candidate architectures
a candidate wins by omitting an orthogonal obligation
implementation momentum or familiarity establishes dominance
Universalist Metanoetic or Reduce takes Actuating selection authority
a mnemonic or tool-call sequence substitutes for the candidate comparison
clauses.rationale: Actuating becomes a counterexample-guided normalizer rather than a greedy patch fold.

success_signals: bounded operations isolate effects independent of executor identity while one Construction remains the semantic realization epoch
closure-grade review begins only after the complete selected Construction is realized
every live production mechanism maps to one selected factor
every live proof mechanism maps to one proof obligation
every superseded mechanism is deleted successor-mapped or justified by a distinct obligation
unmapped production and proof surfaces are empty
wound-specific examples are recomposed around shared causal generators
failure_signals: fresh review starts on a half-realized successor
an unmapped branch validator cache recovery path helper fixture or proof path remains live
multiple same-generator examples remain the governing proof instead of a class-level model
a retirement is conceptual only
clauses.rationale: Obligation-rooted semantic garbage collection prevents review history from surviving as code.

required_artifacts: five request bindings before initial dispatch
success_signals: initial standard plus four auxiliary requests launch concurrently
siblings are non-cancelling
verdictless recovery is request-local and occurs at most once
initial-wave standard clean counts as attempt one
four later standard attempts run serially
five consecutive distinct standard cleans close the exact unchanged subject
material mutation resets all review credit
accepted classes join the cumulative Counterexample Theory before mutation
a noncanonical closure-grade binding is rejected before its findings can authorize mutation
failure_signals: the clean streak is weakened or replaced
a finding maps directly to a patch
review credit crosses a material subject change
invalid review provenance permanently enlarges the implementation
a sibling is cancelled because another request found a defect
clauses.rationale: Repeated nondeterministic review remains a direct stochastic falsification capability.

required_artifacts: current five-clean review convergence when required
success_signals: closure uses only current authority subject proof publication and review evidence
realization exactness and every retirement pass
Ship remains the sole public-effect owner
Actuating authors the semantic closure receipt
five current-subject standard cleans remain mandatory for final closeout
failure_signals: closure accepts an omitted accepted class
closure accepts semantic novelty hidden in a local repair
closure accepts unmapped surface incomplete retirement or stale review credit
Ledger emits or authors the semantic verdict
clauses.rationale: Closure proves the current normalized realization, not the history of patches that produced it.

instrumentation.rationale: Construction Contracts and Evidence events already carry Actuating decision evidence; a separate decision receipt would duplicate authority.
